scenes.text: Claude in Google Sheets: the *$150 spreadsheet cleanup* offer, step by step

scenes.title: Why *this*
lines: Claude's Sheets add-on (Oct 6, public beta) was our most-watched tool reel last week.
Here is how to turn it into a paid offer.

scenes.title: Step 1: *find the mess*
lines: Every small shop has a spreadsheet nobody trusts. Offer a one-time cleanup for $150.
Ask for a copy, never the live file.

scenes.title: Step 2: *the cleanup prompt*
lines: In Sheets: Extensions, Claude. 'Standardize dates, split name into first and last, flag duplicates, add a monthly totals tab with a chart.'
'Ask before edits' is on by default. Approve each change.

scenes.title: Step 3: *the report*
lines: 'Add a Summary tab: top five expenses, months over budget, three one-line recommendations.'
Export to PDF and send it with the clean sheet.

scenes.title: The *upsell*
lines: A $50 monthly refresh: new rows in, summary updated, two sentences from you.
Six clients is $300 a month of recurring work, about an hour each.

scenes.title: *Tested*, not hyped
lines: Claude Pro is $20 a month; the add-on needs a paid plan.
Check every formula before you send. Source: Anthropic, Oct 6, 2026.

scenes.text: Know a shop with a *messy spreadsheet*? Tag them.
